## Chapter Seven

The Void



A three years to the day of Lucas getting transferred he woke to find Dyson smiling at him from the doorway. “I have something to show you” he said motioning to Lucas to join him at the door. A little confused he stood up and came over, putting his head to the door so he could see out one of the spaces that gave them a limited view of the walkway , and Lucas smiled in the next cell , standing just outside was Mouse, carrying his belongings Lucas turned to Dyson “What happened?” he said excitedly, he had not seen or spoken to his friend since his own abrupt transfer. “He was up to be sent to the adult cells, so I pull a few strings and had him put next to us, figured it would be okay with you” Dyson said Lucas smile now infectious.



It was two more agonizxingly slow days until he caught up with Mouse for the first time at mess. “Hey man” he said bumping his smaller friend on the back, Mouse turned eyed Lucas as if he was a stranger and then promptly ignored him. Leaving his friend confused and hurt, why would mouse ignore him, why would he pretent to not know him and what was with that look he gave him, there was actual hatred there. He pondered this all through chow and right up until Lopez kicked him off the weights when he almost dropped two hundred pounds on his own neck while his mind was wandering “Hey Cabrone, go get your head together and the come back eh” Lopez had said shooing him away from the weights.



Lucas tried to spot Mouse in the yard and it only moments to find the other young man, walking the fence perimeter like the two of them used to do . He thought about leaving him be, but dammit Lucas wanted to know why Mouse was treating him like this, he didn’t think he deserved it dammit. With a purpose to his step he made his way over to his old friend and came to walk beside him. Mouse didn’t even register his approach or even appear to notice him. For a while they walked silently Lucas tried to think of the best way to ask and finally gave up, with the straight approach winning out “hey man, what the hell is up?” he simple asked.



But Mouse didn’t answer, didn’t stop hell he didn’t even look at his friend. Lucas grabbed his shoulder to get Mouses attention but as soon as his hand touched the other boy, he quickly spun and punched Lucas in the face, the blow was weak and Lucas had been training non-stop so he was able to roll it off his cheek, it stung a little but more then that Lucas was shocked, what had happened to his friend “Leave me alone” Mouse mumbled, the burning hate still in his eyes as he turned and left the dumfounded Lucas standing next to the wall.



Later in the cell he explained to Dyson what happened. The old man just shook his head “this is not an easy place, you are lucky to have my protection, Mouse didn’t there is no telling what happened to him, it might be best to leave him be, he might come around or he might not, but from the sound of it , you should respect his wishes for now” Lucas nodded and got into his bunk to read, but he couldn’t concentrate, the mouse thing was bothering him, he had thought they were friends, and he had done nothing to the young man, why did he seem to hate him so.



Two days later as he was sitting in the mess hall, Mouse quickly dropped a small note into Lucas’s lap as he passed. Lucas looked up but Mouse never even turned to look at him. Opening the note, he looked over the scrawlings for a moment and the crumpled it up so the guards wouldn’t see it. The note simply read “you feel sick, see medic, we need to talk” Lucas smiled, maybe his friend didn’t hate him, maybe he just needed some time and now wanted to get together to apologize. Lucas felt better then he had for a few days. At excerise he told the presiding guard he felt ill and needed to go see the medic and within thirty minutes he found himself being escorted down the hall.



He was so busy thinking of all the things he wanted to say to his friend that he didn’t notice when the guard turned him down another hall and didn’t follow him. By the time he noticed Lucas turned around to see the guard close and lock the door and walk away. Adrenaline filled his system, something is wrong he thought, but good to his training he spread his feet shoulder length apart and relaxed his muscles. Turning back to look down the hall, he noticed the cameras were off in here. From down towards the other end he heard a chuckle as the sound of multiple sets of footsteps approached. Lucas squinted trying to get a better look at who it was and then his blood went cold. Grigor and Anton emerged out of the shadow slowly and confidently walking towards him. “Your friend interrupted us last time, this time I ensured we would not be disturbed” he said as both men continued to walk slowly enjoying the effect it had on Lucas immensely. “What the hell did you do to Mouse, if you hurt him” Lucas blurted out, getting a laugh from both Anton and Grigor “Oh, we didn’t hurt him, in fact he offered to deliver you to us for a small price, now I see it was worth every penny” Aton answered his thick Russian hard to understand. Or was it that Lucas didn’t want to understand.



His friend had set him up, had delivered him to these phsycopaths for what, money. The kid cleared his mind, he didn’t have time to think about that, he had been training for over three years, but this was the first time he would be facing an opponent who wouldn’t hold back, an opponent who wanted him dead and then looking at the leering face of Anton, he shivered or worse he thought.



The young man took slow steady breaths as he tried to control his fear, flashes of the last time he had encountered these two flashed through his head. Taking a step back the two Russians took it as a sign of weakness, both Grigor and Anton smiling as they separated, one going left the other right. “Oh, we are going to have so much fun child” Anton’s words dripped with menace desire. “Don’t even come near me your sick fuck” Spat Lucas backing up a few more paces, he wasn’t sure how far the door was, but he knew it would be locked, he also knew he didn’t want to back himself into a corner with these two. He had to separate them, allow himself to take one at a time, but he didn’t think he was going to get that luxury.



But his body was fit, and his mind was clear, the last time these two had encountered him, he had been nothing but a scared child.



Grigor stepped in quick, something metal flashing in his had, but before he could reach Lucas the young man’s leg shot out taking Grigor in the knee. He heard the satisfying crunch as the man screamed and buckled to the ground. The metal item skittered across the floor and Lucas could see it was a piece of metal that had been sharpened to a point, so he thought they mean to kill me but before he could continue the train of thought, Anton tried to fake left and then lunged at him, Lucas’s hand shot expertly out to connect with the other mans throat, crushing his larynx and causing him to drop to the floor like his friend.



Lucas walked over listening to the moans of Grigor and the wet choking sounds of Anton and he gingerly picked up the piece of metal, testing its weight. These two were a blight, they were predators who would continue to prey on those weaker then ,themselves holding the small piece of metal Lucas let his mind follow that logic, let it feel the fear he had felt the last time Anton and Grigor had him alone and with a nod to himself he walked over and stuck the piece of metal in the back of Grigor’s neck, feeling it enter between the vertibrea and as soon as it did, the monster that was Grigor ceased to exist, his bowels emptying in his pants and his body slumping to the floor, dead.



He walked over to Anton, watching as the other man , pawed at his throat the look of helpessness on his face, Lucas knew it was only a matter of a few seconds before this man would be dead, he could have finished him quickly, but he wanted this monster to suffer, he wanted him to know that the Lucas would be the last thing this beast would see before meeting his maker. “Don’t like the feeling of being helpless do you Anton old buddy” Lucas whispered as the Russian’s eyes rolled back into his head and he slumped over.



An hour later the guard returned unlocking the door to find two dead Russian and Lucas leaning against the wall staring at them. “I guess this wasn’t the scene you were expecting?” Lucas asked with no humor in his voice. “Oh, what the fuck” the said with panic in his voice as he hit the alarm on his belt. Within a moment six guards had arrived and put Lucas on the ground in restraints as a very unhappy guard got to answer some very uncomfortable questions as to how he got there.



The guards carried Lucas through the bowels of the prison, never letting his feet touch the floor until that arrived outside a Black metal door, the old door slowly slid into the wall, its heavy old metal protesting loudly. Once the door was open it revealed a large Black maw to where the guards quickly tossed Lucas into and closed the door, bathing the young man in complete darkness.



No one spoke to him, no one addressed him, nothing, he just sat in the middle of a room in complete darkness.



For the first few hours he let the deaths of Grigor and Anton play over and over in his head but it wasn’t long before he was questioning wether he had done the right thing, He wasn’t a killer, that wasn’t who he was, he was a teenager, he didn’t like conflict, didn’t like to fight , he was normal. “But what is normal hoss” came another voice from within him, a colder voice, but one that was his own.



The nights, or what he thought of as the nights since he had no reference to day or night, and the only even that happened was the sliding of the bowel through the small opening near the floor as they fed him once a day.



In the dark your mind can turn on you, can become your enemy, can try to destroy you Lucas thought, now fifteen days in the dark room he had found himself more and more talking to his father and his mother and even Mouse. “I am not going to go mad” he told himself trying to make his voice sound more convincing then he felt. “No Lucas, you are already there” his father whispered “This is where you will spend the rest of your life, this is the cost of your betrayal” Mouse whispered from his right “My betrayal” he yelled now angry at his friend “I wasn’t the one who led me into a trap” then he remembered, Mouse wasn’t really there, well neither was his father, was he even here, was this a real place or just somewhere in his mind, was he really laying on the floor bleeding out having lost the battle with Grigor and Anton he thought, Lucas took his thumbnail and cut into his arm, had there been light anyone could have seen the hundreds of matching cuts as this was not the first time he used this technigue to check if he was really conscious and here, in this place of cold and darkness, his own personal hell he thought.



Lucas had no idea of time in the void he found himself, he spent his days arguing with anyone who passed through, he spent two days yelling at his father for putting him in this god forsaken place and a day at his mother crying with her, for her dying and leaving him and of course apologizing more then once to Tommy for abandoning him when he had been taken away. Lucas knew they weren’t real, or thought he knew, but sometimes he forgot, sometimes he actually thought he was there, the only passage of time that was consistent was his once a day meal and once a week washing from the sprinklers in the ceiling, he had stopped using the hole in the corner to relieve himself and just sat in his own excrement allowing the water to wash it away, he had long ago lost his clothes and the cold no longer bothered him.



One day the door opened shining a bright light across the floor, Lucas could barely lift his arms to shield them as his muscles had atrophied for sitting sedentary so long in the darkness.



Three guards walked in after the sprinklers had finished with him and picked him up off the floor. Lucas wasn’t sure if they were real or not, he kept asking them, but no one spoke to him. Either from the stress or exaughstion he passed out as they carried his emaciated body down the hall.
